movie.title: Ladies First
movie.overview: An arrogant but charismatic ladies' man finds his life of money, power and casual flings upended when he wakes up in a parallel world dominated by women.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: An arrogant and sexist advertising executive finds his life turned upside down when a head injury transports him into a matriarchal parallel world where women hold all the power.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Damien Sachs is a high-powered, chauvinistic executive whose charmed life of wealth and casual flings crashes when a head injury sends him into an alternate universe run entirely by women. In this matriarchal reality, men face workplace objectification, condescension, and systemic discrimination while women hold top corporate positions. Clashing with his formidable female colleague, Alex Fox, Damien is forced to navigate flipped power dynamics to climb back up the corporate ladder. Through his comedic struggles to survive, he gains a firsthand understanding of the sexism he once perpetuated.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Damien Sachs, a wealthy and chauvinistic advertising executive at Atlas, spends his life using women for career advancement and casual affairs. When a key client demands better female representation in leadership, Damien hastily promotes long-overlooked employee Alex Fox as creative director to cover himself. Following a heated confrontation with Alex, Damien accidentally knocks himself unconscious and awakens in a parallel world where gender roles are entirely reversed. In this matriarchal reality, women dominate corporate boardrooms, objectify men, and subject male workers to condescension and systemic inequality. Guided by a mysterious figure known as the Pigeon Man, Damien learns he must earn the CEO position in this new world if he hopes to restore order to his life. As Damien competes fiercely against Alex for top leadership at Atlas, he experiences the humiliating double standards and objectification he used to inflict on female colleagues. Over time, his intense workplace rivalry with Alex softens into mutual respect and unexpected romantic chemistry as they spend time together. After being fired and subsequently taking legal action against the agency, Damien gains power only to realize how toxic and corrupt the oppressive system truly is. Returning to his original reality with a changed perspective, Damien makes genuine amends to Alex, stepping aside to give her the creative authority she deserves. Ultimately, Damien learns that true leadership requires empathy, equality, and dismantling systemic double standards rather than exploiting them.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Ladies First is a satirical gender-swap comedy that follows Damien Sachs, a charismatic yet blatantly sexist executive at a top advertising firm. Obsessed with status, wealth, and surface-level conquests, Damien's entitled life hits a sudden wall when a head injury transports him to a parallel universe where women hold all corporate power and societal influence. In this inverted reality, men face the daily objectification, patronizing corporate culture, and systemic barriers that Damien once casually imposed on others. Forced to compete from the bottom against his sharp and ambitious colleague, Alex Fox, Damien must adapt to a world where his usual tactics fail. The film uses sharp workplace satire and gender role reversals to explore power dynamics, systemic bias, and the journey toward genuine empathy.

story_structure.climax: He is forced to confront his past attitudes and choices during a high-stakes turning point where he must truly stand up for himself without relying on his old patriarchal privileges.
story_structure.conflict: After an unexpected event, he wakes up in an alternate reality where societal gender roles are completely flipped, placing women in positions of power and authority.
story_structure.resolution: Through his experiences on the other side of gender inequality, he gains deep empathy and perspective, fundamentally changing how he views power, respect, and romantic partnerships.
story_structure.introduction: An arrogant, womanizing protagonist enjoys a life of privilege, wealth, and effortless romance, firmly comfortable in his male-dominated world.
story_structure.risingAction: Struggling to adapt, he faces constant prejudice, patronizing behavior, and systemic barriers while attempting to navigate relationships, career challenges, and the absurdities of this new matriarchal order.
